title: Content-Disposition filename allows semicolons — header parameter injection
description: lib.rs:271 filters filename to printable ASCII excluding quote/slash/backslash, but allows ';' and '='. A name like 'foo; filename=bar.exe' in the URL path produces 'attachment; filename="foo; filename=bar.exe"' — ambiguous to some RFC 6266 parsers. Fix: also strip ';' from the allowed character set.
